products.name: Hex Bolt (Full Thread)
products.description: Hexagonal-head bolt threaded along its entire length for maximum thread engagement. The most common general-purpose structural bolt with a six-sided head for wrench tightening.
products.threads: Metric Coarse & Fine | UNC / UNF / BSW

products.name: Hex Bolt (Half Thread)
products.description: Hexagonal-head bolt with a partially-threaded shank — the unthreaded portion provides shear strength in load-bearing structural connections.

products.name: Carriage Bolt
products.description: Round-head bolt with a square shoulder beneath the head that prevents rotation once installed. Widely used in wood-to-metal and timber connections.

products.name: Eye Bolt
products.description: Forged eye bolt with a circular loop head for lifting, rigging and anchoring. Available in shouldered and non-shouldered types in carbon and stainless steel.

products.name: U Bolt
products.description: U-shaped bolt used for clamping pipes, tubes and round sections to structural supports. Available in round bend, square bend and semi-round configurations.
products.sizes: M6 to M36 | Pipe OD 1/2" to 24"

products.name: Foundation Bolt
products.description: L-bolt, J-bolt or hooked foundation bolt cast into concrete to anchor columns, base plates and heavy machinery to the foundation slab.

products.name: Flange Bolt
products.description: Hex-head bolt with an integrated flange beneath the head that distributes load and eliminates the need for a separate washer. Often serrated to prevent loosening.

products.name: High Tensile Bolt
products.description: Heat-treated alloy-steel hex bolt manufactured to property classes 8.8, 10.9 and 12.9 — engineered for high preload and demanding mechanical applications.

products.name: Structural Bolt (HSFG)
products.description: High-Strength Friction-Grip (HSFG) heavy-hex structural bolt — supplied as bolt-nut-washer assembly for slip-critical steel-to-steel connections.

products.name: Hex Nut
products.description: Six-sided hexagonal nut — the most common nut style for use with hex bolts and threaded fasteners across all industries.
products.material: Mild Steel (MS) / Stainless Steel (SS) / Brass / Alloy Steel

products.name: Flange Nut
products.description: Hex nut with an integrated flange beneath that acts as a built-in washer, distributing load and resisting loosening (often serrated).

products.name: Cap Nut (Acorn)
products.description: Domed acorn-style nut with a closed end that covers the bolt thread for safety, weather protection and finished appearance.

products.name: Wing Nut
products.description: Nut with two large 'wings' for hand-tightening and frequent removal — no tools required.

products.name: Square Nut
products.description: Four-sided nut providing a larger bearing surface than hex nuts. Often used in channel sections and slotted track applications.

products.name: Weld Nut
products.description: Nut designed to be welded onto a metal surface — available in hex, square, T-projection and round-base configurations.

products.name: Self Tapping Screw
products.description: Hardened screw with a sharp point that cuts its own thread into pre-drilled holes in metal, plastic or wood.

products.name: Self Drilling Screw
products.description: Combines a drill-point tip with a tapping screw — drills its own hole and forms threads in a single operation, no pilot hole required.

products.name: Machine Screw
products.description: Uniform-thread fastener for use with a tapped hole or a nut — available in pan, flat, round, fillister and oval head styles.

products.name: Wood Screw
products.description: Tapered screw with a coarse, deep thread for fastening into wood. Available in flat, round, oval and bugle head styles.

products.name: Sheet Metal Screw
products.description: Fully threaded hardened screw with sharp threads for fastening thin sheet-metal sections, HVAC ducting and metal cladding panels.
products.threads: Type A / AB / B sheet-metal threads

products.name: Socket Head Cap Screw
products.description: High-strength cap screw with a cylindrical head and internal hex (Allen) drive. Provides a clean look and high torque capacity.

products.name: Plain Washer
products.description: Flat round washer used to distribute the load of a threaded fastener across a wider surface area.
products.material: Mild Steel (MS) / Stainless Steel (SS) / Brass / Alloy Steel

products.name: Spring Washer
products.description: Split helical washer that creates spring tension under load to resist loosening from vibration. Most common locking washer style.

products.name: Star Washer
products.description: Toothed (star) washer with sharp internal or external teeth that bite into the joint surfaces, providing both anti-rotation grip and electrical bonding.

products.name: Lock Washer
products.description: Hardened washer with serrated edges (internal or external tooth) that bite into the joint to prevent loosening.

products.name: Fender Washer
products.description: Oversized flat washer with a small hole and a large outside diameter — distributes load across thin or soft materials such as sheet metal.

products.name: Wave Washer
products.description: Curved spring washer with three or more 'waves' that provide controlled axial deflection — used to take up tolerances and dampen vibration in light assemblies.

products.name: Sleeve Anchor
products.description: Pre-assembled anchor consisting of a threaded stud, expansion sleeve, nut and washer. Suitable for solid concrete, brick and block.

products.name: Wedge Anchor
products.description: Heavy-duty mechanical anchor with an expanding wedge clip that grips concrete as the nut is tightened. Highest holding power for solid concrete.

products.name: Chemical Anchor
products.description: Threaded stud bonded into a drilled hole using a two-part epoxy or polyester resin. Highest load capacity, ideal for cracked concrete.

products.name: Expansion Anchor
products.description: Heavy-duty expansion-shell anchor that expands radially as the bolt is tightened, providing high pull-out resistance in solid concrete.

products.name: Drop-in Anchor
products.description: Internally-threaded female expansion anchor flush-set into concrete. Allows removable threaded fasteners — ideal for ceilings and overhead.

products.name: Solid Rivet
products.description: One-piece solid rivet that is hot- or cold-formed during installation. Provides the strongest, most permanent rivet joint.

products.name: Blind Rivet (Pop)
products.description: Tubular rivet (also called pop rivet) installed from one side of a joint using a blind-rivet tool. Ideal where the rear of the joint is inaccessible.

products.name: Semi Tubular Rivet
products.description: Rivet with a partial bore (drilled hole) at the tail that allows easier setting with less force than solid rivets.

products.name: Drive Rivet
products.description: Hammer-driven rivet with a pre-set pin in the body — installation is by simply hammering the pin flush with the head.

products.name: Fully Threaded Rod
products.description: Continuously-threaded all-thread rod sold in standard 1m / 3m lengths and cut to length on site for stud bolts, hangers and through-bolting.
products.threads: Metric Coarse & Fine | UNC / UNF | ACME

products.name: Double End Stud
products.description: Double-end stud with equal or unequal thread lengths on both ends and an unthreaded center shank. Used where bolts cannot fit due to space constraints.

products.name: Tapered Stud
products.description: Stud with tapered (interference-fit) thread on one end for permanent installation in cylinder heads, engine blocks and high-temperature equipment.
products.material: ASTM A193 B7 / B16 / Alloy Steel

products.name: High Tensile Threaded Rod
products.description: High-strength fully-threaded rod made from heat-treated alloy steel (Property Class 8.8 / 10.9 / 12.9 or ASTM A193 B7) for demanding flange and structural service.

products.name: Stud Bolt
products.description: Fully threaded stud bolt manufactured from ASTM A193 Grade B7 chromium-molybdenum steel, supplied with two heavy-hex nuts. Designed for high-temperature, high-pressure flange connections.

products.name: Customized Fastener
products.description: Bespoke fasteners manufactured to customer drawings — special head shapes, drilled heads, oversized lengths, captive washer assemblies and unique thread profiles.
products.threads: Metric / UNC / UNF / BSW / BSP / Custom
products.material: Mild / Carbon / Alloy / Stainless / Brass / Titanium

products.name: Anchor Bolt
products.description: L-shaped, J-shaped or straight foundation bolt for embedding in concrete to secure structural columns, heavy machinery and equipment bases.

products.name: Lock Nut (Nylock)
products.description: Self-locking nut with a nylon insert (Nyloc) that grips the bolt thread to resist vibration loosening. All-metal prevailing-torque variants also available.

products.name: Countersunk Screw
products.description: Flat-head countersunk socket screw with 90° head angle for flush mounting in machinery, panels and architectural metalwork.

products.name: Construction Anchor System
products.description: Engineered anchoring solution combining mechanical and chemical anchors with rebar doweling, baseplates and connectors for cast-in and post-installed structural fixings.

products.name: CNC Machined Part
products.description: Precision CNC-machined components produced on multi-axis lathes and machining centers — fasteners, shafts, fittings, bushings and complex parts to tight tolerances.
products.material: MS / SS 304 / SS 316 / Brass / Aluminium / Inconel / Titanium

products.name: Precision Turned Component
products.description: High-volume precision turned parts produced on Swiss-type and CNC traub lathes — pins, dowels, bushings, spacers, inserts and fittings to micron-level tolerances.
products.material: Brass / SS 304 / SS 303 / Aluminium / EN1A / Free-cutting Steel

products.name: Non-Standard Fastener
products.description: Engineered non-catalog fasteners — left-hand threads, micro-fasteners, fine-pitch specials, headless shoulder bolts and proprietary designs unavailable in standard catalogs.
products.threads: LH / RH / Acme / Trapezoidal / Custom Pitch
products.material: Per spec — Steel / SS / Brass / Bronze / Titanium

products.name: Railway Fastener
products.description: Track-fastening hardware for railway and metro applications — fish bolts, sleeper screws, elastic rail clips, dog spikes, anchor bolts and tie plates.
products.material: Carbon Steel / Alloy Steel / Spring Steel

standards.name: ASTM International (American Society for Testing and Materials)
standards.description: ASTM standards (such as A193, A194, A320, A325, A490, F1554) are the global benchmark for high-strength bolting in petrochemical, oil & gas, power generation, and structural steel applications. They define chemistry, mechanical properties, heat treatment, testing, and marking requirements.
standards.scope: Mechanical and chemical specifications for fasteners, alloy steel bolting materials, stainless steel bolting, structural bolts, and anchor bolts.
examples: ASTM A193 B7 — Cr-Mo alloy stud bolts
ASTM A194 2H — Heavy hex nuts for high-temperature service
ASTM A320 L7 — Low-temperature alloy bolting
ASTM F1554 — Anchor bolts (Grade 36/55/105)

standards.name: American National Standards Institute / American Society of Mechanical Engineers
standards.description: ANSI/ASME standards govern the dimensional, threading, and head-form requirements of fasteners. ASME B18 covers bolts, screws, and nuts, while ASME B1 governs unified inch (UNC/UNF) and metric (M) thread profiles. Compliance ensures interchangeability of fasteners worldwide.
standards.scope: Dimensional and thread standards for inch and metric series fasteners — hex bolts, heavy hex, socket products, studs, washers, and nuts.
examples: ASME B18.2.1 — Square and Hex Bolts and Screws (Inch)
ASME B18.2.2 — Nuts for General Applications
ASME B1.1 — Unified Inch Screw Threads (UN/UNR)
ASME B18.3 — Socket Cap Screws

standards.name: Deutsches Institut für Normung (German Institute for Standardization)
standards.description: DIN standards are the cornerstone of European fastener manufacturing. DIN 931, 933, 934, 976, and 6914 define metric hex bolts, full thread bolts, hex nuts, threaded rods, and high-strength structural bolts. Most DIN standards are gradually being superseded by ISO equivalents while remaining widely specified in industry.
standards.scope: Metric fastener dimensions, threads (DIN 13), property classes (DIN EN ISO 898), surface treatments, and tolerances.
examples: DIN 931 — Hex bolts with shank (partial thread)
DIN 933 — Hex bolts fully threaded
DIN 934 — Hexagon nuts
DIN 976 — Threaded rods (studs)
DIN 6914 — High-strength structural hex bolts (HV)

standards.name: International Organization for Standardization
standards.description: ISO standards harmonize fastener specifications globally, succeeding many DIN standards. ISO 4014, 4017, 4032, 4033, 898-1, and 3506 are the most commonly cited for metric bolts, nuts, mechanical properties, and stainless steel fasteners.
standards.scope: Globally accepted dimensions, mechanical properties, and quality assurance requirements for metric fasteners.
examples: ISO 4014 — Hex bolts, partial thread (formerly DIN 931)
ISO 4017 — Hex bolts, full thread (formerly DIN 933)
ISO 4032 — Hex nuts (formerly DIN 934)
ISO 898-1 — Mechanical properties of fasteners
ISO 3506 — Stainless steel fasteners

standards.name: British Standards (BSI)
standards.description: British Standards (BS) for fasteners include BS 3692, BS 4190, BS 4395, and BS EN 14399 governing high-strength friction grip (HSFG) bolts widely used in UK structural steel, infrastructure, and bridge construction. BS Whitworth (BSW) and BS Fine (BSF) thread forms remain in use for legacy and heritage equipment.
standards.scope: Imperial and Whitworth thread series, HSFG structural bolts, and general-purpose UK fasteners.
examples: BS 3692 — ISO Metric Precision Bolts, Screws, and Nuts
BS 4190 — ISO Metric Black Hex Bolts and Nuts
BS 4395 — High-Strength Friction Grip Bolts (HSFG)
BS EN 14399 — High-strength structural bolting assemblies

standards.name: Indian Standards (BIS)
standards.description: Indian Standards (IS) issued by the Bureau of Indian Standards govern fasteners used across Indian infrastructure, railways, power, and manufacturing sectors. IS 1364, 1367, 3757, and 6639 align closely with ISO standards while addressing local material specifications.
standards.scope: Hex bolts/nuts, technical supply conditions, HSFG bolts, and threaded rods for Indian industry.
examples: IS 1364 — Hexagon Head Bolts, Screws, and Nuts (Product Grade A & B)
IS 1367 — Technical Supply Conditions for Threaded Steel Fasteners
IS 3757 — High Strength Structural Bolts (HSFG)
IS 6639 — Hexagon Bolts for Steel Structures

standards.name: Society of Automotive Engineers
standards.description: SAE standards (J429, J995, J1199) define grade-rated bolts and nuts for automotive, aerospace, and heavy-duty mobile equipment. SAE Grade 5 and Grade 8 fasteners are heat-treated medium-carbon and alloy steel bolts used in critical mechanical assemblies.
standards.scope: Mechanical and material requirements for inch-series bolts, screws, and studs in automotive applications.
examples: SAE J429 — Mechanical and Material Requirements for Externally Threaded Fasteners
SAE J995 — Mechanical and Material Requirements for Steel Nuts
SAE J1199 — Mechanical and Material Requirements for Metric Externally Threaded Steel Fasteners

standards.name: European Norms (EN / EN ISO)
standards.description: EN and EN ISO standards harmonize fastener requirements across the European Union. EN 14399 covers high-strength structural bolting assemblies for preloading, and EN ISO 4014/4017/898-1 govern dimensions and mechanical properties for metric fasteners CE-marked under the Construction Products Regulation.
standards.scope: CE-compliant high-strength bolting and harmonized European fastener standards.
examples: EN 14399-1..10 — High-strength structural bolting assemblies for preloading
EN ISO 4014 — Hex bolts (partial thread)
EN ISO 898-1 — Mechanical properties of carbon steel fasteners

standards.name: Ente Nazionale Italiano di Unificazione (Italian Standards)
standards.description: UNI standards are the Italian national specifications for fasteners, often referenced in Italian and Mediterranean industrial projects. Many UNI standards have been harmonized with ISO/EN equivalents but remain specified in legacy and Italian-engineered equipment.
standards.scope: Italian dimensional and material standards for hex bolts, nuts, washers, and threaded fasteners.
examples: UNI 5737 — Hex bolts (equivalent to DIN 931 / ISO 4014)
UNI 5739 — Hex bolts fully threaded (equivalent to DIN 933)
UNI 5588 — Hex nuts
